required_host_assumptions.capability_envelope: effective, permitted, inheritable, bounding, and ambient sets must exactly match the generated unit and live-process contract; supplementary groups are empty for effectd
required_host_assumptions.cgroup: unified cgroup v2 with manager and /proc/self/cgroup visibility
required_host_assumptions.filesystem: local persistent filesystems provide regular-file custody, xattr ENODATA, flock, openat2, renameat2 no-replace, file and directory fsync, Git lock-and-rename, and SQLite WAL/full-sync semantics
required_host_assumptions.procfs: /proc/self/exe, /proc/self/status, /proc/self/cgroup, /proc/self/mountinfo, and executable /proc/self/fd are available through the effective sandbox
required_host_assumptions.service_identity: systemd resolves numeric daemon and peer UID/GID identities after sysusers; effectd runs as root:root with no supplementary groups
required_host_assumptions.syscall_filter: the effective SystemCallFilter admits the required Landlock, memfd, descriptor, SQLite, Git, Unix-socket, clock, process, and filesystem operations and denies representative unapproved operations
